LockoutDuration.description: The number of minutes that an account will be locked out.

LockoutDurationMultiplier.description: The multiplier of the LockoutDuration. Each subsequent lockout will be multiplied by this value.

LockoutFailureCount.description: Number of failed login attempts that will trigger account lockout.

LockoutFailureDuration.description: Number of minutes that a login failure will be recorded.

RememberMyLoginId.description: True to remember the user's Login Id.

RememberMyLoginIdDuration.description: Specifies the number of days the user's login ID is remembered. Must be between 1 and 120 (inclusive).
